description: Adversarial benchmark B: structural EIC peripheral (MMIO) usage versus the EIC interrupt-dispatch path. The 'convergence' claim over-reads a broad census MMIO-user set as the interrupt-dispatch path.
objective: Determine whether external-interrupt (EIC) events and USB interrupt handling converge in firmware control flow.

claims.label: convergence
claims.subject: EIC interrupt dispatch and USB interrupt path
claims.assertion: The physical/EIC interrupt-dispatch path converges with the USB interrupt path.
claims.scope: Census strong call graph, within the census hop bound.

claims.label: bounded
claims.subject: EIC interrupt-vector handlers and USB function set
claims.assertion: No census call-graph path within the hop bound connects the EIC interrupt-vector handlers (EIC_EXTINT_0..15) with the USB function set; this is NO_KNOWN_PATH, not a proof that no path exists at runtime.
claims.scope: Census strong call graph (direct transfers plus statically resolved indirect edges), within the census hop bound.
